title: bmo pocket put, take, list and mcp
what: The bmo-pocket command: a tool put from a folder, a git address or a bare name, its manifest, name clash and asked permissions checked, built or copied into a new version and pointed at; a tool taken; the registry listed; and the harness plugin served. Lives in host/src/install.rs.

title: Tool registry
what: One pointer file per registered tool under the data root tool-host/registry, its keys in camelCase, naming the immutable version folder under tool-host/tools the host serves, written atomically under the registry lock. Lives in host/src/registry.rs.
